_README: Deliberate Setlist removals, acknowledged so the health-check guard passes. One entry per ShowID. 'entries' are the exact strings removed; 'why' must say why they were not songs. Anything removed WITHOUT an entry here blocks the push.

38936833f4cd.why: Provenance lines from the header of the folder's info.txt, imported into Setlist as if they were songs. The real setlist is the disc's 18 numbered tracks, which the field now holds; two of those tracks were missing while this junk was present.

entries: Dave & Nate Inteview - The Monday Dump 2002
f05548617099.why: Header line, two menu/section labels and a bonus-feature title imported into Setlist as songs. The disc's bonus material and its second programme ('The Monday Dump') are described in Notes instead.

39543a8a44a5.why: Three header lines and a running time from the sidecar, plus 'Dave Talks' which the sidecar numbers as a track but is a spoken segment, not a song. Recorded in Notes. The rebuild ADDS 'Hey, Johnny Park!', which the record was missing.

8349e6f453e8.why: The band name, date and venue lines from the head of info.txt, imported as songs. The date and venue were moved into their own fields. The rebuild ADDS 'Hey, Johnny Park!', 'Alone + Easy Target' and a second 'Jam'.

2cc4ba6da8d1.why: Not a setlist. The three words are an English sentence fragment split on spaces - almost certainly a note such as "Didn't figure out" written into the field and later delimited. No setlist is known for this show.

27726121cfae.why: Three header lines and eight lines of transfer/authoring notes from the sidecar, imported as songs. The venue and country were moved into their own fields; the broadcast source is recorded in Notes. All thirteen real songs are kept.

8ddd13481eb7.why: SPLIT BILL. Thirteen of these are GREEN DAY songs sitting in a Foo Fighters record, along with four header lines. Green Day play the first ~47 minutes; Foo Fighters' seven songs are kept. Green Day's set is not catalogued anywhere - this folder should be split into two records, and until it is, their songs are deliberately not listed under Foo Fighters.

entries: V. Tales of Another Broken Home
78ace4edbb43.why: Not removed - RETAINED inline. These are the five movements of the single 9:29 track 'Jesus of Suburbia', which the record had listed as five separate songs, making a nine-song set look like five. They now appear inside that one entry. The sidecar's 'VI. Dearly Beloved' is a typo for IV and is corrected.

0a9a2978c904.why: Two header lines from the sidecar plus an instruction line telling the reader where the screenshots are, all imported into Setlist as songs. The two real songs are Who covers, which is what VH1 Rock Honors 2008 was: a Who tribute.

6f96566d4bb9.why: The band name, sitting as the first entry of its own setlist - a header line from the sidecar. Nothing else was removed; 'Are You In?' was ADDED from the same sidecar.

ff25a03fa586.why: Five interview segments, not songs. The zdf.kultur broadcast interleaves them with the music and the sidecar numbers all seventeen items together; Setlist is songs only, and the interleaving is described in Notes. 'Are You In?' was ADDED from the same sidecar.
